mapper.select: select count(*) as totalCount from interconnection where deleted = false
select connect_status as status, count(*) as count from interconnection where deleted = false and third_platform = #{cooperator} group by connect_status order by connect_status
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM interconnection WHERE deleted = false AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC
